paper.title:
Physics of Language Models: Part 3.1, Knowledge Storage and Extraction Thanks: Project page: https://physics.allen-zhu.com/part-3-knowledge/part-3-1 . An extended video of this paper is available at https://youtu.be/YSHzKmEianc .
V1 was circulated internally at Meta on Sep 18, 2023, and appeared on arXiv on Sep 25, 2023.
V2 is nearly identical to V1, with minor corrections to author names and writing.
V3 includes additional Llama experiments and further writing improvements. We would like to thank Lin Xiao, Chunting Zhou, Tianyi Peng, Xiaodong Liu, and Zhijie Zhou for many helpful conversations. We would like to extend special thanks to Nabib Ahmed, Giri Anantharaman, Lucca Bertoncini, Henry Estela, Liao Hu, Caleb Ho, Wil Johnson, Apostolos Kokolis, and Shubho Sengupta from Meta FAIR, as well as Ian Clark, Gourab De, Anmol Mann, and Max Pfeifer from W&B ; without their invaluable support, the experiments in this paper would not have been possible.

result.summary: 这篇论文研究语言模型如何在训练中记忆事实知识并在推理时提取这些知识，区分了“逐字记忆”与“可提取的知识记忆” [S1.p3]。作者构建了包含 10 万个人物传记的合成数据集 bioS 和由 Llama 生成的接近真实的 bioR 数据集，并用问答（QA）框架评估知识提取 [S2.p1][S2.p6]。实验发现，仅在传记上预训练再微调 QA 的模型无法对未见过 QA 的个体进行知识提取，而知识增强（如多版本、句子置换、重复全名）能大幅提升提取准确率 [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS2.p3]。通过近乎线性的探测技术，作者表明知识增强促使模型将人物属性近乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏表示中，从而支持后续提取 [S5.SS2.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：语言模型回答事实性问题时，是基于训练中见过类似问题（即“作弊”），还是真正学会了从维基百科等来源提取知识 [abstract]。作者指出，先前研究使用互联网数据预训练的模型，无法确定其回答是来自传记知识提取还是训练中见过相同/相似问题 [S1.p5]。因此，论文聚焦于模型需要从训练语料中记忆、编码到权重并在推理时提取的事实性知识 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: do they answer such questions based on exposure to similar questions during training (i.e., cheating), or by genuinely learning to extract knowledge from sources like Wikipedia?

leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
We focus on factual knowledge (e.g., knowledge graph) that a language model needs to memorize from the training corpus, encode in its weights, and extract later during inference.

method.text: 论文采用受控的合成数据集方法，构建了包含 10 万个人物传记的 bioS 数据集，并用 Llama 生成接近真实风格的 bioR 数据集 [S2.p1][S2.p4]。模型在全部传记上预训练后，用一部分个体的 QA 对进行微调，测试对剩余个体的分布外知识提取能力 [S1.p7]。此外，论文提出基于位置（P-probing）和基于查询（Q-probing）的近乎线性探测方法，分析知识在隐藏状态中的编码方式 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we introduce synthetic human biography datasets and near-real datasets generated by LLaMa.
We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama. For the set of $N=100,000$ individuals, we provide an instructive prompt to Llama to generate a biographical entry.

After pretraining the model on the entire biography, we fine-tune it using question and answer (QA) pairs from a $p$ fraction of individuals. We then test its ability to out-of-distribution answer QAs about the remaining $1-p$ fraction.
We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing). Both methods employ simple, nearly-linear probes to extract personal attributes from the model’s hidden states.

experiments.text: 实验在合成数据集 bioS 和 Llama 生成的 bioR 上进行，包含 10 万个人物，每人有六个属性（出生日期、出生城市、大学、专业、公司、工作城市）[S2.p6][A1.SS1.p1]。模型采用 GPT2/Llama 架构，在 bioS 上使用 124M 模型，在 bioR 上使用 302M 模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。评估包括混合训练和预训练+微调两种设置，并测试多种知识增强（多版本、置换、重复全名）的效果 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p3]。此外，还使用 GBERT 模型进行双向模型的对比实验 [S7.p2]。

evidence.quote: For each individual, we pose six questions targeting their six unique attributes: 1. What is the birth date of Anya Briar Forger? Answer: October 2, 1996.
In the synthetic dataset labeled as bioS, we generate profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
We focus on three augmentations: adding multiplicity, introducing permutations, and repeating full names, typically found in internet data.
We analyze the BERT model, similar to GPT2 but with a full attention matrix, allowing every token to attend to every other token.

findings.text: 混合训练（同时使用传记和 QA）能使模型对未见过 QA 的个体进行知识提取，在 bioS 上达到 86.6% 的分布外准确率 [S3.p2]。然而，仅在传记上预训练再微调 QA 的模型，即使完美记忆传记，也无法对未见过 QA 的个体进行知识提取，准确率接近零 [S4.SS1.p2]。知识增强（如多版本、置换、重复全名）能显著提升提取准确率，例如从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。探测实验表明，知识增强促使模型将属性近乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏状态中，从而支持提取 [S5.SS2.p4]。此外，对部分个体（“名人”）进行知识增强也能提升对未增强个体（“少数群体”）的提取准确率 [S6.p1]。双向模型（如 BERT）在提取知识方面效果较差，除非知识是独立单词 [S7.p8]。

evidence.quote: As shown in Figure 1(a), the OOD generalization accuracies are $86.6\%$ when mixed-trained on bioS single and $77.7\%$ for bioR single.
Despite a 99+% first-token accuracy during pretraining, the model exhibits zero-zero QA accuracy on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$ for all finetuning parameters.

Pretraining on a dataset where each person has 5 diverse biography entries (i.e., different wording, sentence shuffling) boosts the QA fine-tune accuracy (on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) from 9.7% to 96.6%.
This suggests that the model encodes knowledge almost linearly in the hidden states directly adjacent to the person’s name.
This section explores whether partially augmenting data can improve knowledge extraction for non-augmented data.
Unless the knowledge is a standalone word or of independent words (like month, day, year), extracting knowledge after MLM pretraining might prove challenging, if not totally impossible.

limitations.text: 论文作者指出，本研究主要使用合成数据，可能无法完全反映真实互联网数据的复杂性 [S8.p1]。此外，作者提到在混合训练中，模型表现出类似“应试学习”的非正常行为，这与人类学习过程不同 [S3.SS1.p3]。作者还指出，对于双向模型，MLM 预训练任务不一定促进知识存储，除非知识是独立单词 [S7.p8]。

evidence.quote: Using synthetic data allows for greater control over the training and fine-tuning of models, which is essential for understanding how different data sources impact the internal mechanisms of transformers.
This is akin to the “study to pass the test” approach in schools, where students prepare using past exam questions and textbooks for answers.
While bidirectional models like BERT is less sensitive to knowledge ordering, the MLM pretraining task does not necessarily promote knowledge storage for subsequent extraction.
